The workbook generation failed due to incorrect formula logic or cell references in the 'net metric' calculation, resulting in uniform incorrect values.
The verifier failed in `test_derived_values_and_stats` within `/tests/test_outputs.py`. Specifically, `assert_matrix` reported multiple mismatches in the 'net metric' section (rows 36-40, columns H-L). For example, cell H36 expected -4.0727 but got -7.0000, and H37 expected 4.0697 but also got -7.0000. The repetition of the same incorrect value (-7.0000... and -6.2678...) across different rows suggests a failure to correctly map row-specific inputs or a hardcoded reference error in the underlying OpenPyXL formula generation.
